limitations: Reused calendar periods are development, never fresh holdout.
No actual order book, historic funding, provider fill or live evidence.
Two symbols pooled as independent signal outcomes, not portfolio or Prop account performance.
All trials disclosed; selecting among them creates multiple-testing bias.
OHLC stop-first and same-candle breakeven are conservative; no intrabar path inferred.
MAE/MFE includes whole exit candle; never calibrated only on winners.
